search_text: published ZDI-10-196 ZDI-CAN-822 SAP Crystal Reports JobServer GIOP Request Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2010-10-12 10.0 ['SAP'] ['Crystal Reports'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of SAP Crystal Reports. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the JobServer.exe process which listens by default on several TCP ports above 1024. When parsing a GIOP request, the process trusts a user-supplied 32-bit value and allocates a buffer on the heap. The process then proceeds to copy the string following this value from the packet until it finds a NULL byte. By crafting a specifically sized packet a remote attacker can overflow the buffer and gain code execution under the context of the SYSTEM user. The process then proceeds to copy the string following this value from the packet until it finds a NULL byte.
